displayName: Fanatics Merchandise API - Jersey Prices, Sales, Sizes, League Shops
description: Fanatics merchandise API as structured JSON - search fanatics.com, 7 international Fanatics storefronts (UK, Germany, France, Spain, Italy, Japan, Canada in English or French) or the US league stores (NFL Shop, MLB Shop, NHL Shop, MLS Store) for jerseys, hats and fan gear, or browse a team, player, league section, department, brand or collection, or the Sale, Clearance and Under-25 lists, up to 72 products per page with the current, regular, sale, clearance and with-code price (the site's public promo code), ship-by and delivery estimates, facets with team, player, size and department ids; read one product with every size's availability and stock level (low / out, never unit counts), personalization fields and the team roster, Jersey Assurance and authentic flags, the active promo code and the rating with fit, value and quality; read US review text with four sorts and a star filter, rolled up across the style. 5 endpoints, 1 credit each. Merchandise only, no sportsbook or odds data.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent validate API outcomes instead of assuming success?
Did the agent preserve evidence for request/response behavior and error handling?
